question: _____________ is/are an item for which both, GST and central excise duty are applicable in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tobacco and tobacco products.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• On** Tobacco and tobacco products, GST and central excise duty** are applicable in India.
 
• **GST **(Goods and Services Tax) is a consumption tax that is levied on the **sale of goods and services** in India.
 
• **Central excise duty** is a tax on the **production or manufacture** of goods in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **GST** is a digital version of** VAT** that allows you to track products and services.

 
 
• The tax slabs for GST and VAT are the **same.**
 
 
 
• A** shop or an intermediary collects** central excise duty from a client as an indirect type of taxation.
 
 
• When the products are moved from the **production line to a warehouse,** they get paid.
 
• The **Central Excise Tariff Act of 1985** and the **Central Excise Act of 1944** both oversee this specific tax.
 
 
 
• Even though liquor hasn’t been brought under the purview of Goods and Services Tax, it still falls under other taxes that contribute to its rising prices. These taxes are:
 
 
• **Excise Duty**
 
• **VAT (Value Added Tax)**
 
 
 
• **Petroleum products**, on the other hand, are subject to GST and a different type of excise duty called the** Central Excise Duty** and **Additional Excise Duty**, but not the central excise duty mentioned in the question.
 
• All agricultural commodities are **exempt from GST,** but some of them may be subject to other taxes or duties depending on their nature and usage.
